what: Dozens of photo panels (thickness .0175 box, repeated if fewer than 20) lined up in one row at .375 spacing and rotated −30°, with panels further right set further back (z = −x × aspect ratio × 1.5, × 6 on portrait screens) sent out so the panels overlap as a staircase crossing the screen diagonally. A camera with a 5° field of view looks down from (0, 13.3, 35). It spins endlessly, following the wheel (one notch ÷ 20) at .15 per frame and dragging at .1. Only the hovered panel slides out of the row to the right .667 and down .1 over .5s expo.out, the title tag trails the cursor at .1, and while dragging (.15s after press) the scene shrinks to .825x over .75s expo.out. The outer 15% of each panel edge melts into a blurred panel (opacity .75). On entry the panel row streams in from −20 notches over 2s expo.out, and the scene starts at .825x and returns to full size over 1s after a 1.25s delay. A short press on a panel (within .2s) leaves only that panel, which turns to face front over 1.25s expo.inOut while the camera moves right up close (30, 35 on narrow screens), then fires fx:open

options.start: With wait, the panel doesn’t enter until fx:start arrives (when opening after loading). Default is immediately on attach. fx:start’s detail { grow: false } If so, skip the scene zoom-in (.825 → 1) and only let the panel lines flow in (when returning to an already seen scene)
options.fov: Camera field of view (deg), default 5 — smaller looks flatter and more stacked
options.from: Number of cells where entry starts, default −20
options.slide: Distance the hovered panel pulls out, default .667
options.follow: Share that follows the wheel (per frame), default .15
options.min: Minimum number of boards to repeat-fill, default 20
options.hold: Seconds until it returns to the row after opening a panel without href, default 1.2
options.[data-fx-part=tile]: One panel: data-title (tag text) · data-ratio (height/width) · data-label (what kind of photo to write in the placeholder) · href or data-href (where to go on open), inside If available, that photo
options.fx:open: On the Board After Opening { index, title, href } — It is cancelable, so if the caller calls preventDefault and pages by itself (e.g. a cover wipe), the part does not page.
options.--fx-tile-1…4 · --fx-tile-line · --fx-ti: Placeholder panel’s four tones, diagonal and label color (default mixes --kf-ink into the background at 6–38%)

use: Project 01…
note: Like magazine-ribbon (orthographic page strip · one-slot snapping · wavy bend), this is a ‹slanted photo row›, but it has a perspective camera, endless continuous flow and plates that pull out on hover, so it is kept separate. For the wheel it uses _vendor/virtual-scroll if loaded (arrow keys and space too, like the original), otherwise it takes the same values from the wheel event. It listens only on mouse (hover) devices. On touch it turns by dragging only, and the plate nearest the centre pulls out by .325 while the rest step aside by −.325. Touch scrolling is not blocked (touch-action: pan-y). With reduced motion, the entrance and pull-out finish instantly.
